_comment: VERIFIED contents of each screenshot. Every entry was read by OPENING the image,
never inferred from the filename. A caption may only cite a figure listed in
'kind' drives rotation: max 1 'dashboard' per 3 image posts.
'tier': 'core' = small real numbers, safe for regular use.
'rare' = large figures. Shawn's rule: at most ONCE PER MONTH, and only
framed as what the screenshot literally says (a payout, a past
month) - never as 'today' and never implying current run-rate.
Anything not listed here must be opened and recorded before it can be used.
